author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

These modules instances appear to be unused in the HLT phase-2 menu.
We deprecate them because they use directly `l1tLayer1EG` which should not be used directly for the HLT usage (see also [here](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1708153/contributions/7184379/attachments/3313893/5931303/EGM_HLT_Phase2Upgrade_Roundtable_14.07.26.pdf#page=5)).

#### PR validation:

`runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt -i all --ibeos` runs without issues.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

N/A
title: remove unused instances of `L1TTkEleFilter` and `L1TTkEmFilter` from the Phase-2 HLT menu
